newExplicitNativeSemantics.dated: ACT/365F daily-base Horner. Compute bounded positive daily-base endpoint brackets by native Decimal34 bisection of the 365th power. Horner gaps are exact civil day counts; report the 365th power of the fitted daily base minus one, and retain the original annual-rate limits. newExplicitNativeSemantics.numericPolicy: Original FinnorDecimal precision 34, HALF_EVEN, minE=-100, maxE=100 and normalized length limits unchanged. Saturation to zero is modeled where the new Horner operation intentionally encounters it.
